items.desc: French bishops took "courageous" steps when faced with "the painful scourge of abuse of minors," Pope Leo XIV told the high-ranking clerics before his scheduled meeting with survivors at the Catholic shrine of Lourdes.

items.title: UK: 5 arrested after 'major incident' near Fairford air base
items.titleOrig: UK: 5 arrested after 'major incident' near Fairford air base
items.desc: Scores of homes were evacuated in the UK town of Whelford, near an air base used by the US military, with bomb disposal teams checking "suspicious vehicles" at the scene. Police said five men had been arrested.

items.title: European cities seek ways of boosting affordable housing
items.titleOrig: European cities seek ways of boosting affordable housing
items.desc: In many major urban centers of Europe, the housing shortage has become an explosive social issue. DW looks into various models that have been put in place across the continent.

items.title: Switzerland: Voters reject stricter view of neutrality
items.titleOrig: Switzerland: Voters reject stricter view of neutrality
items.desc: Early projections show Swiss voters rejecting a stricter application of the country's vaunted neutrality. Swiss neutrality has been enshrined in the constitution since 1848.

items.title: Germany news: Are Germans giving up their beloved meat and sausages?
items.titleOrig: Germany news: Are Germans giving up their beloved meat and sausages?
items.desc: Germans used to be all about sausages and meat. While those do remain popular, things seem to be slowly changing. There also are new insights into the economic side of East Germany's espionage DW has more.

items.title: Northern Ireland: Pro-UK march to go through Catholic area
items.titleOrig: Northern Ireland: Pro-UK march to go through Catholic area
items.desc: It's the first time the march has been allowed to go through the area since 1997. Overnight, a court ruling allowed it to take place after a series of last-minute legal challenges that reached Belfast's High Court.

items.title: India news: Kolkata's SRFTI students allege violent attack
items.titleOrig: India news: Kolkata's SRFTI students allege violent attack
items.desc: Students at Kolkata's Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute say they were attacked with knives after confronting an outside group over a meeting they allege was affiliated with the right-wing Hindu RSS. DW has more.

items.title: Iran sticks to Hormuz plan after Trump rejects it

items.titleOrig: No public mentions of Taiwan at official Xi and Trump meeting
items.desc: At a high-profile summit between Presidents Donald Trump and Xi Jinping in Washington, there was much talk of trade and artificial intelligence. One of the most contentious issues, Taiwan, was only discussed in private.

items.title: China sends two giant pandas off to Atlanta zoo after Xi-Trump summit
items.titleOrig: China sends two giant pandas off to Atlanta zoo after Xi-Trump summit
items.desc: Ping Ping and Fu Shuang took off to Atlanta on a FedEx plane, with steamed corn buns, carrots and bamboo to snack on during the flight. Their trip is one of the few concrete things to come out the Xi-Trump summit.

items.title: Gunmen kill 27 people in two mass shootings in South Africa
items.titleOrig: Gunmen kill 27 people in two mass shootings in South Africa
items.desc: South African police have launched a search for suspects after 17 people were found dead at a tavern southwest of Johannesburg. A separate tavern shooting near Cape Town left 10 dead.

items.title: Spain: Thousands protest in Madrid against housing crisis
items.titleOrig: Spain: Thousands protest in Madrid against housing crisis
items.desc: Tens of thousands rallied in the Spanish capital after an 87-year-old woman was dramatically evicted from her home this week. Protesters called for measures to curb rising costs and reduce evictions.

items.titleOrig: Backlash over data centers tests Europe's AI ambitions
